question: Can cheap geometry-aware probes replace most blind native KiCad via-relocation trials without hiding failure or collapsing the retained portfolio to one numerical boundary point?

preliminary_without_diversity.result: all four retained relocation slots passed native KiCad but converged on the same obstacle boundary within micrometres
preliminary_without_diversity.why_rejected_as_a_portfolio: byte-distinct boundary refinements did not represent meaningfully different actions, so four expensive native gates provided almost one action's information
preliminary_without_diversity.corrective_change: score-ordered geometric non-maximum suppression with 0.1 mm minimum candidate spacing

comparison_to_sequence_033_lattice.interpretation: the analytic filter makes the expensive portfolio more informative on this via, but 646 CPU geometry probes and one fixture do not establish a general speedup

continuous_ablation.conclusion: the continuous gain is again identical to the fixed-via control, so the better seed remains an additive discrete gain rather than evidence of a new relaxation basin

worked: every relocation sent to native KiCad was already analytically clear and all four passed
the same one-millimetre search radius used eight fewer native board evaluations than the lattice
the selected raw and post-relaxation candidates are both modestly shorter than the lattice controls
the preliminary same-boundary collapse remains visible and directly motivated diversity suppression
did_not_establish: the bounded angular/radial samples are not a complete representation of the continuous feasible region
fixed 0.1 mm non-maximum suppression is scale-dependent and may discard useful nearby alternatives
the experiment did not remove a via or reduce the twelve-via physical count
the relocation still did not change the continuous relaxation basin
one branch-local via is insufficient evidence for performance or quality on the wider tree
critical_evaluation.next: pair remove-via actions with a bounded local rerouter so removal can detour around occupied copper instead of replacing the excursion with one illegal chord; retain direct-chord failures as controls and test the frontier on additional vias before tuning its sampling policy
